reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her #central-random thread. The ticket is #8841.

Where it comes from: yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27) Tobias said in #central-random that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on ticket #8841 for support.

One gap I pointed out to her: Tobias's message calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks. I'm assuming they're the same account because of the Jan 2 Central handoff digest. It calls Marrow Fieldworks Pree's dealer account and says it was handing over on Jan 5. I suggested she check with Tobias before the customer call if she needs to be sure.

I also warned her not to mix it up with #88412, the older Tansleigh Packaging Door 6 ticket.

I only used what Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team and the public Central digests.
